stateKeys.name: verified
stateKeys.type: boolean, did a verification pass on this run

stateKeys.name: reason
stateKeys.type: string, why the run ended without pushing ('' otherwise)

specialRules.name: a-failed-verification-ends-the-run
specialRules.note: VERIFY_FAILED goes straight to 'blocked'. The point of the workflow is that the push is unreachable from there, so there is nothing to stage.

specialRules.name: stale-completions-reject
specialRules.note: A report arriving in a state that does not await it is an observable rejection (post == pre), never a fault. Several sessions may share these orders.
specialRules.whenAction: VERIFY_PASSED | VERIFY_FAILED | STAGED | COMMITTED | PUSHED | PUSH_FAILED

provenance.subject: git push
provenance.note: Steps taken from the 12 pushes that share a lead-in. See NOTES.md.
